messages:
sarah.k: Heads-up: vendor confirms pen test next week. Need to finalize: ephemeral KMS plan, minimal RBAC changes, evidence packaging, and retest cadence. I put a short checklist in the tracker.

mike.ops: Link? I can stand up ephemeral roles and a short-lived CMK alias. Prefer to do a dry run before the window.

sarah.k: https://drive.google.com/fake/pt-tracker-2026 (sheet: 'pt-evidence-and-sla'). Please add columns for owner + dry-run status.

olivia.se: For KMS access, we should avoid giving decrypt rights. Plan: create envelope keys, upload encrypted bundles to S3, give assessors a pre-signed URL + wrapped DEK. Document will include manifest + sha256.

jason.eng: Agree. I'll add a terraform snippet to create alias/pt-ephemeral-<run>. Minimal change: single CMK, restricted policy, and tag for auto-delete. Example snippet I'll paste in tracker.

mike.ops: Proposed download flow for assessors: 1) request S3 URL 2) assume ephemeral role with sts:GetFederationToken 3) download object. I'll add cli example.

security-bot: Vendor "red-team-inc" scheduled: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-05. Evidence window will be exported daily.

nina.ciso: SLA question: what are our ack & remediation turnaround targets? Also need escalation steps for Criticals.

sarah.k: Draft SLA in tracker: Critical: ack <3h, mitigation plan <48h, retest slot within 5 business days. High: ack <8h, plan <5 business days. Medium/Low: ack in 3 business days. Thoughts?

olivia.se: Add constraint: PII must be redacted unless assessor has documented exception. Add checklist item in tracker: redact -> generate manifest -> compress -> wrap DEK.

jason.eng: RBAC approach: do targeted canary role grants on a small subset of resources first (logs bucket + readroom demo), run smoke tests (download manifest + verify sha256), then expand. Revoke if smoke fails. I'll write an ops playbook.

mike.ops: I'll pre-create the alias and put exact aws cli commands in the sheet. Also will script generation of pre-signed URLs so we can rotate them hourly during the window.

sarah.k: Dry run: Friday 14:00 UTC. Goals: generate an evidence bundle, wrap with CMK alias, upload to S3, and have an assessor (test account) download & verify manifest.

nina.ciso: Ack for dry run. Also request that all remediations hit the tracker within 2h of a finding being assigned so we can follow SLA. Add an exec escalation list for Criticals.

olivia.se: One more: sampling guidance for app logs. Provide full CloudTrail for the window. For app logs, deliver full contiguous slices for suspicious intervals and sampled elsewhere. Include timestamp ranges in manifest.

jason.eng: I'll add a smoke test script snippet:```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2026-06-01/bundle.gz - | sha256sum -
```

mike.ops: And the wrap example:```bash
# create data key
aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/pt-ephemeral-2026 --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > dek.blob
# encrypt object locally with dek then upload
```

sarah.k: Action items (add to tracker): mike.ops: alias + pre-signed url tooling (due Thu EOD). jason.eng: RBAC canary + smoke tests (due Thu EOD). olivia.se: manifest template + redaction checklist (due Wed). nina.ciso: confirm SLA + escalation list (please ack).

nina.ciso: Acked. I'll add escalation contacts and confirm exec email + pager.

mike.ops: Ack. I'll include the CLI snippets and a rollback step to immediately revoke the assessor role.

jason.eng: Ack. I'll include terraform for minimal CMK policy and an automated cleanup that tags keys for deletion after 14 days.

sarah.k: Thanks team. Please update the tracker as you complete items. Ping in this thread if blockers show up. We'll run the dry run Friday and close the loop. :white_check_mark:
